description:
the two spatial-nr stages' raw grade values now ride every render
seam end to end, so a grade using chroma denoise (stage 7) or noise
reduction (stage 8) stays on the gpu path instead of falling back
to the cpu develop with unsupported=chroma-denoise,noise-reduction.

the threading, parameter order locked as (chromaDenoise,
noiseReduction) directly after the plumbing values:

  after frameIndex, nativeDevelopSessionRenderFrameToEncoder after
  ptsUs, nativePreviewSessionRenderFrame after maxDim; each entry
  populates its request struct (DevelopFrameRequest /
  PreviewFrameRequest) with the raw values before exposureEv,
  mirroring the c++ call sites' clamp-and-gate math. the doc
  comments list the widened control set.
- NativeSource.kt: the three external decls plus their three
  wrappers (jniDevelopSessionRenderFrame,
